notes.title: Sitrep: Showdown Massive Update
notes.content:
[p]Dear Contractors, [/p][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled to finally roll out today’s massive updates for Contractors Showdown, on both ExfilZone and BR Mode. We know we’ve kept you waiting and we’re truly sorry for the delay. But every extra day went into making sure this update is our biggest and best yet. The wait has been worth it![/p][p][/p][h1]Gunsmith Update for ExfilZone[/h1][p]Check out the launch trailer:  [url="https://youtu.be/ODJlfuYjvQU"]ExfilZone Gunsmith Update Launch Trailer[/url][/p][p][/p][p]This wipe is evolutionary, with the first ever Gunsmith System in VR as well as other exciting new content and upgrades! Let's break into exciting details:[/p][p][/p][h2]Gunsmith System[/h2][p]It’s a game changer. You would have over 600 attachments, 54 lower receivers, 14 attachment categories, and 100+ shop preset weapons. Mix and match barrels, stocks, sights, and suppressors to forge hundreds of unique weapon builds. Shape a loadout that fits your style, gain a new edge in every raid, and carve your legacy into ExfilZone.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/c9e481690e68806eb0c8dbf210295e31cc20ba75.gif"][/img][/p][p]Auto Mode: One-tap recommended builds for instant deployment.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/b7d4d18c2c9ca3d49500f2d82d642d3c0328827b.gif"][/img][/p][p]Manual Mode: Take total control with hands-on tuning for every weapon part[/p][p][/p][p]Preset System: Save and swap your favorite builds instantly between raids[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/7f988d589f15543b51c822bb8ea700612ae5dd0f.gif"][/img][/p][p]New Vendor: A dedicated trader who stocks weapon parts, and sprays to fuel your builds and presets.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/5aea02274aad1c7252d676e0cac26b948ee86828.gif"][/img][/p][p]Spray System: Get creative with spray patterns and make them truly your own[/p][p][/p][h2]New Weapon[/h2][p][/p][p]As requested by many of our player base: M870-DM, M1A, RFB, Vector-9, Vector-45, P226, SA58, MP5K, MP5A4, Vpo-136, Akalpha, RD-704[b] [/b]will make their debut with the wipe. [/p][p][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/b65ab982fbc289fdc36f2ab281acdf3838b1cd31.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/3130ce8e399e8823df687fdb68459641d85c502f.gif"][/img][/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/8982eab3900c5c5f903b904f3c379fbbfcb9d325.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/5d1ae5534542c670e5391ca802b898203f49d90b.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/35ae58da706514c94244cdda5d8fef1e3327fcad.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/75129f3f62577ce5bb21fd9baf796a47d7918ed9.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/3d15d4f67c2742317de44358f3c7af4f4e3baea6.gif"][/img][/h2][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/c6ddb19aebd1d95a7cd41f68d86d314f3cbd1031.gif"][/img][/h2][h2][/h2][h2]New DLCs[/h2][p]5 additional content packs arriving alongside the wipe. Expect themed gear bundles, and cosmetics to expand your arsenal and your style.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/c19d531a060d29249901e7c7d8a76aea6b1b0ec1.png"][/img]  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/d689c757b35b0c1621c9da62a754cb6777e08367.png"][/img] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/91c6ddd889d5c32153fd6f9639deef3f735c9912.png"][/img]  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/934a93b09b1da15265e0b891e50c7a6e46f3be1d.png"][/img]  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/4a72301baa826f5ef6c4b46ef773b7698a34805c.png"][/img]  [/p][h2]New Map: Smuggling Tunnel[/h2][p]A sprawling four-level underground battleground for up to 9 players. Expect interconnected paths, hidden stashes, evac points, and multiple access routes. This is the most complex map we’ve built. And it’s free to enter. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/5c60a68738388f0af608db20ef48f42f81593b87.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/067972393b2e074317f5d3e010f08535c2f0da5c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Revamped Hideout[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/d3d2f1a1777b1859f5b6ade5cc8bd25089f056c8.gif"][/img][/p][p]Workshop is introduced. You can spend time building your one and only loadouts there. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/4c4cd0367be2cd8682fd05e875808acb048236de.gif"][/img][/p][p]Fast Buy. Grab your favorite items right from your hideout skipping the second-floor market run.[/p][p][/p][h2]UE5 Upgrade[/h2][p]ExfilZone now runs on Unreal Engine 5 with enhanced lighting, textures, and performance.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/aba7cac952b08f10b902c91ce981b30d95306cb2.gif"][/img][/p][h2]More Missions[/h2][p]Total quests have been increased to 208, with 2 brand new questlines of Gunsmith and Smuggling Tunnel. [/p][p][/p][h2]Upcoming New Anti-Cheat[/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve fully heard your concerns about cheating. To address this, we’re going to upgrade our anti-cheat solution to help keep our game fair and enjoyable for everyone. Please stay tuned for future updates on this. [/p][h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2][p]We also focus on the “small but important” parts of the game so that your overall game experience is improved: [/p][list][*][p]Terminal now shows available and active quests per map.[/p][/*][*][p]Added loot preview to map terminal.[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned game mode selection screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized and rebalanced difficulty across maps.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted loot distribution across maps.[/p][/*][*][p]Revised rewards for existing weapon-related quests.[/p][/*][*][p]Added/adjusted spawn positions for certain quest items.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified unlock requirements and quest progression order.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted reputation, XP, and item rewards for certain quests.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked some quest objectives and descriptions.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1]BR Mode Update[/h1][p][/p][p]We’ve also been refining the BR mode to make matches faster, tighter, and more rewarding:[/p][p][/p][h2]New Locations[/h2][p]Introducing new locations across the BR map: Tanker Bar, Sewage Plant Site, Car Graveyard, Forest Villa, Hunter’s Camp, Lumber Yard, Raider Camp, Checkpoint.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/a4f29c0cd8aaa540643bc3212dc9245b3414dc6c.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/71afc7d7deb7bf29d03b45303e10aa3e5d81fa1d.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/5c7fa1a2f54c1cfb487112adf25f1611c377a8df.jpg"][/img]  [/p][h2]Trio Mode Focus[/h2][p]Trio mode will be the only way to play. This change will deliver faster matchmaking and create a more competitive, high-intensity experience.[/p][p][/p][h2]Optimization[/h2][p]We’ve reworked map art in many areas to better reflect realistic environments. Visuals for vegetation, rocks, and natural terrain are also enhanced. [/p][p][/p][p]Movement and gunplay now lean more toward the ExfilZone-style, with a noticeably slower and more tactical pace.[/p][p][/p][p]This update marks a major milestone for Contractors Showdown. A full wipe, the revolutionary gunsmith system, a four-level Smuggling Tunnel map, the upgraded hideout, new DLCs, and a sleeker Battle Royale mode are all ready for you. We can’t wait to see how you’ll adapt to the new battlefield and what dark secrets you’ll uncover in the new map.[/p][p][/p][p]For the detailed patch note, check out our discord community: [/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/contractorsshowdown"]https://discord.com/invite/contractorsshowdown[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Stay sharp. We’ll see you in the Smuggling Tunnel.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you![/p][p]Caveman Studio[/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]

notes.title: Sitrep: ExfilZone Wipe Date & Battle Royale Update
notes.content: [p]Hey Contractors, [/p][p][/p][p]Hope you’re enjoying the summer while gearing up for the upcoming ExfilZone wipe. We’re working hard to bring you fresh experiences and more reasons to grind the game. With just a few weeks until the big update, here’s the latest news on both ExfilZone and the Battle Royale mode.[/p][p][/p][h2]ExfilZone Wipe Date[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/60566f3de3fd947a687f23059510a0088a166c03.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Get ready—the battlefield is about to reset! We’re thrilled to announce that the [b]2nd Wipe[/b] Update for ExfilZone is targeting in for[b] September 4th, 2025[/b]. Gear up, and prepare for a fresh start packed with new challenges and opportunities to dominate the raids. To make things even more exciting, we’re kicking off a [b]pre-wipe event[/b] starting the weekend of [b]August 23rd, 2025[/b], designed to send off the current season with a bang![/p][p][/p][h2]What’s Coming in the 2nd Wipe Update?[/h2][p]The upcoming wipe isn’t just a reset—it’s a full-on evolution of ExfilZone. Here’s a sneak peek at what you can expect:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Gunsmith System – A VR Revolution[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/a26af5ee0f59b6b4c70ca3947cdc1a29889248ac.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Introducing the Gunsmith System, a groundbreaking, one-of-a-kind feature never before seen in VR gaming! This isn’t just customization—it’s a game-changer. Assemble hundreds of unique weapon variants by combining an extensive array of weapon parts, from barrels and stocks to sights and suppressors. Craft the ultimate loadout tailored to your playstyle, offering unparalleled depth and creativity. Build the perfect weapon to dominate the raids and leave your mark in ExfilZone’s history![/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Deployment Zone: Smuggling Tunnel[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/60f69cc389bc5da414c18c87f1b11e57c64a52c1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A brand-new map that shakes up the tactical landscape! Smuggling Tunnel brings tight corridors, sneaky routes, and high-stakes loot opportunities that’ll test your skills and strategies like never before. Get ready to adapt or get outplayed.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Expanded Missions & Challenges[/b][/h3][p]We’re cranking up the mission count with new objectives that push your creativity and combat prowess. From photo-taking tasks to specific loadout kills, expect over 50% more missions to keep you grinding.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Why This Wipe Matters[/b][/h3][p]This wipe is more than just a reset—it’s a chance to redefine your legacy in ExfilZone. With new content, refined mechanics, and a level playing field, everyone gets a shot to rise to the top. The early-wipe grind is where legends are made, so bring your A-game and outsmart, outshoot, and outlast the competition.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for sneak peeks at the brand-new gunsmith system, the comprehensive new map, and our upgrade to UE5.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Pre-Wipe Event: August 23rd Weekend[/b][/h3][p]To celebrate the end of this season, we’re hosting a [b]pre-wipe event[/b] starting [b]August 23rd, 2025[/b]. Expect wild surprises, exclusive rewards, and a chance to flex your skills before the wipe resets the board. Whether you’re a veteran contractor or a fresh recruit, this event will be the perfect way to go all-out before the new season drops. Stay glued to our official [b]Discord[/b] ([url="https://discord.com/invite/contractorsshowdown"]https://discord.com/invite/contractorsshowdown[/url]) and [b]X[/b] ([url="https://x.com/contractorsvr"]https://x.com/contractorsvr[/url]) for event details as we get closer.[/p][p][/p][h2]Battle Royale Update[/h2][p]We know BR players have been waiting for improved matchmaking and fresh additions—thank you for your patience. Alongside the ExfilZone update on September 4th, the Battle Royale game mode will also be getting big changes.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New locations [/b][/h3][p]Discover fresh areas to ambush enemies or team up with your squad, adding new tactical opportunities to every drop.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/6a60da3d926d2ce19509f6068ee43158179bc49a.png"][/img]  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/8173f7e5dbc20909bac951e7f32ab58695c626b2.png"][/img]  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/564c098a829dd13be325c166d32bd2038bc10666.png"][/img]  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/9f5e20ed7ddb972864260abf278b118c75285127.png"][/img]  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/320c142736861ce0c3dc3a68029344b6a0632ccd.png"][/img]  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/da3b92659fb12d08630a4da9b31ff888ce644098.png"][/img]  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/384dbae9651541e3d230f29c7e856d16e794d6e8.png"][/img]  [/p][h3][b]Mode Adjustments[/b][/h3][p]For smoother matchmaking and stronger team dynamics, BR will focus on Trio and Reborn modes, setting Solo aside for now. This should mean faster queuing and more intense squad play. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Map optimization[/b][/h3][p]We’re updating the central areas of Showdown Island for better tactical flow—whether you’re rushing across open ground or locking down key positions.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/bbbc689ba0805a703e65937da199ab3033cffa27.png"][/img]  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/ad2f0bd0753f463d60075e17a5400ef14e3df3de.png"][/img]  [/p][h3][b]Core Gameplay Updates[/b][/h3][p]Several system updates are on the way, including a major reduction in ziplines and other adjustments aimed at tightening gameplay.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your relentless support, feedback, and passion. This wipe update is built for [i]you[/i], and we can’t wait to see how you conquer Smuggler’s Tunnel, master the Gunsmith system, and dominate the raids. For the latest details, join us on [b]Discord[/b] ([url="https://discord.com/invite/contractorsshowdown"]https://discord.com/invite/contractorsshowdown[/url]) or follow us on [b]X[/b] ([url="https://x.com/contractorsvr"]https://x.com/contractorsvr[/url]).[/p][p][/p][p]Gear up, Contractors. The wipe is coming—let’s make it legendary![/p][p][/p][p]Caveman Studio[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Situation Report: ExfilZone Upcoming Wipe Update & July Update
notes.content: [p]Dear Contractors, [/p][p][/p][p]It’s been almost 3 months since the first wipe of ExfilZone. We hope you’ve been enjoying your raids, and we want to thank you for all the huge support for this alpha-stage game mode since December 2024.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve been listening closely to your bug reports and your requests for new content. Thanks to your feedback, we rolled out patches and ran events like Metro-Free. But we know you’re longing for more than fixes and events.[/p][p][/p][p]So, let’s talk about what’s coming with the next wipe update![/p][p][/p][p]Gunsmith Announcement Trailer:[/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PBrPk9rVLsk"]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PBrPk9rVLsk[/url][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Gunsmith System[/b][/h3][p]Yes, we hear you—you want more weapons. So, with the next wipe, we're taking it a step further: now you can build your own! The new Gunsmith System empowers you with the freedom to mix and match components and attachments, crafting truly unique weapons tailored precisely to your style. And yes, you can even select your own colors.[/p][p][/p][p]This innovative system vastly expands the ExfilZone gun library, opening up endless possibilities for one-of-a-kind builds that are exclusively yours![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/49ae58283421b16cb0b9caec7e67e24ef859c537.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/d2c526ee10e7fb6092269a607338e5682e97bb23.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/6e1808ce397e77092340bed1c0a095f2678adeb6.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/62c5661c33a97b0fe1c316d26517aa2bae3fe04d.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/ab4bd12da055bb580af68c8a8741302e9ea58ee3.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Map[/b][/h3][p]No wipe update is truly complete without a fresh playground to conquer. Introducing "Smuggler's Tunnel"—a thrilling new map that injects a whole new vibe into the mix, shaking up strategies and offering endless tactical opportunities. We're betting this one will skyrocket in popularity, and we're beyond pumped to dive deeper—stay tuned for more juicy details in the coming weeks![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/18ed1453ab8c04520712ea56b0d4098298bbace0.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/316cbf6a740dba03477ea2a5d15909635f86dc4b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/d93c32f23124e195f32c62975c0fc02bd4b0c5dd.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]UE5 Upgrade[/b][/h3][p]You’ve probably noticed from the screenshots above—we’re upgrading from UE4 to UE5! This means ExfilZone will look better with improved lighting and effects, and give us the tools to build larger, more detailed maps in the future. What’s more, this upgrade will thoroughly fix the bug where items fall through the ground. It’s a big step toward making your raids feel even more immersive.[/p][p][/p][p]Please stay tuned for more news on the upcoming wipe update with the Gunsmith System, Smuggler's Tunnel Map and UE5 upgrade! [/p][p][/p][p]While we’re heads-down prepping the next wipe, we’re also making sure your current experience stays smooth and fun. [/p][p][/p][p]We’re cracking down on cheating, adding a new collectible item, and getting ready to launch an exciting airdrop event from the weekend of July 19th:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Cheating Update & EAC Improvements[/b][/h3][p]We want to take a moment to acknowledge the recent concerns around cheaters in the game. We're fully aware of the impact this has on your experience, and we want you to know that it’s a top priority for us.[/p][p][/p][p]With the next update, we’ll be rolling out an updated version of Easy Anti-Cheat (EAC). This will include improved detection and enforcement measures designed to catch and remove cheaters more effectively.[/p][p][/p][p]This is just one step—we’re continuing to monitor, adapt, and take action behind the scenes. Your reports help, and your feedback matters.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience and continued support. We're committed to keeping the game fair, competitive, and fun for everyone.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Collectible Posters[/b][/h3][p]We're excited to introduce a fresh collectible to the game: posters! Collect them up, and transform your personal space into a customized showcase.[/p][p][/p][p]How to Get Them[/p][p]Acquire posters through various thrilling avenues—scavenge them as rare drops across the map, redeem one type of the posters from the shop, and earn another type by participating in special events.[/p][p][/p][p]How They Work[/p][p]Posters are conveniently stored as compact rolled-up tubes, making them easy to stash in backpacks, storage crates, junk boxes, and beyond.[/p][p][/p][p]Placing and Removing[/p][p]Placing posters follows the intuitive weapon wall system. Simply approach a suitable wall with a poster in hand, and a helpful ghost preview will appear to guide your positioning. To remove one, walk up empty-handed, grab the edge, and hold Grip to peel it off effortlessly.[/p][p][/p][p]What's Available[/p][p]Launch with 4 official posters plus 1 community-created gem, with plenty more in the pipeline. Dive in, collect, customize, and flaunt your unique style—this is only the start of endless personalization![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Airdrop event[/b][/h3][p]Introducing the Flare Gun: a potent, high-stakes utility item that adds a thrilling layer of risk and reward. It slots seamlessly into your holster as a secondary weapon and pairs perfectly with all backpacks. Like med injectors, it's designed for one-time use, dropping from your grip right after firing.[/p][p][/p][p]How It Works[/p][p]The Flare Gun remains inactive until you enter a designated flare zone on the map. Once positioned inside, squeeze the trigger to propel a vibrant flare soaring into the sky, kicking off the excitement.[/p][p][/p][p]Airdrop Mechanics[/p][p]After launch, an airdrop crate—packed with awesome gear and premium loot—will touch down at a predetermined spot linked to that map's flare zone. Keep in mind, each map hosts only one active launch zone per match, and it triggers solely for the very first flare fired—making your timing absolutely critical to seize the advantage.[/p][p][/p][p]Things to Keep in Mind[/p][p]The Flare Gun self-destructs after a single shot—no reloads possible. When you fire it, expect handling akin to a standard handgun for that familiar, intuitive feel.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for being the most important part of this journey. We can’t wait for you to try out all the new content and share your feedback on what could make ExfilZone even better.[/p][p][/p][p]For more updates and to stay connected with the community, join our Discord:[/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/contractorsshowdown"]https://discord.com/invite/contractorsshowdown[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all![/p][p]Caveman Studio[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Situation Report: ExfilZone Wipe Update
notes.content:
Dear Contractors, 

The wait is over! ExfilZone is going to have the first wipe update since the launch of Alpha last December. We appreciate the participation and engagement from the community. And we are especially thankful to your tolerance and feedback, helping us improve this brand new game mode in Alpha. With the end of the pre-wipe Beer Festival, we are officially bringing in the wipe update to you. 

#1 New Deployment Zone: Resort 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/6fab2ef546c3ad91347e66ed6e9108c4b1f54f8c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/7b7a293bdaa54be7d2321b5ae88a1b842315e257.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/8696f3224a6c710715c3f1c9cf6bae0600f1dfe0.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/376607a2fff6e168a51fc1ae1be3bbd24a8ff911.gif[/img]

Welcome to Resort – a fresh urban combat environment designed for tactical showdowns, where players can engage in multi-layered combat from ground level to rooftops to underground tunnels. And 3 new bosses await your challenge at the Resort. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/bf6cf2da12198e9545087241134e448e214de204.gif[/img]
The introduction of air-drops will also enhance game experience through the high risky loots. Air-drops will be randomly available in the maps of Suburb, Dam, and the new Resort.

#2 Safe Container System
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/16fe0f7847a495830ee00ae1319b9478906f72f9.gif[/img]
The new Safe Container System lets you secure items during raids. Items placed inside the container—including the container itself—will not be lost upon death. Safe containers will be acquired through missions.
However, we also try to ensure the motivation and essence of the extraction game. Keys, quest items and certain gears can not be placed in the containers. 

#3 Updated Hideout
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/6dc5aca171cde5f0057b83554266db182e55e0f9.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/0b02acf127699c86c00d732ee94c6ab0efa7b2a2.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/05cd25e32d410449a537fcd1d2d0557dbf01afb4.gif[/img]
The Hideout has undergone a major overhaul to improve functionality. The weapon wall now supports not only weapons, but also armor, helmets, and backpacks, while the new Medical Storage Box and the Accessory Storage Box offer better item organization. The new Career Stat Page tracks your performance, giving you a clear record of your progress, achievements, and combat history.

#4 Smoother Store Experience
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/75d5d24ad570a42ae0cf9b994e0cda8fe941469b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/a7354d9ae52f7c43aa37f833468d5e5b3f6b7d93.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/a00385b45cf988fe4e4d7086307ffb2a0c1590b4.gif[/img]
You can now buy related items with your purchase. You can also choose to send the items to your kiosk or have them available at the trader where you bought them. Magazine purchases have also been upgraded—ammo can now be selectively added when you shop.

#5 New Weapons
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/a99fcaf416b5aa37980ed710bbe21f958f9190ce.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/e2aed68ebb893c5167ca9160fbd02b5a25a8f790.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/87a51025f4c10378a138a8e1fa500098bbd0172a.gif[/img]
A full lineup of G3 rifles has been introduced, offering diverse builds from classic to tactical variants. The PSG-1 Designated Marksman Rifle also joins the arsenal, built for precision at long range. New attachments include Falcon scopes, and magazines, rails, drums for all G3 variants. These additions expand your loadout options going into different raids.

#6 Mission Expansion
The number of missions is increased from 96 to 150, over 50%. What’s more, new types of missions are introduced: taking photos, placing items or killing with specific loadouts. More challenges and more variety. 

#7 Revamped Medical System
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/25774543cf13ad5eb5c26c31407475ee290a1141.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/999dd3c7da7fb902b00ea23a336be2ae655233da.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/d10c75f30e6da0dbf7acc91bc9524e1aefdf4397.gif[/img]
A new status, Deep Wound, causes ongoing health and hydration loss until properly treated. Suture devices, advanced bandages, and tiered painkillers offer more strategic healing options. Medical equipment now features durability displaced as battery level.

#8 Item Distribution Adjustments
The loot system has been expanded with over 40 new items. Once killed, scavs now also drop the gear they carry, including backpacks. The item spawn system has also been optimized.  

#9 Female Characters
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/7a2842cde5be77de197cc2f4219d1354070eaa17.jpg[/img]
Two new female characters have been added, offering broader and more diverse options for players at the start.

Alongside the latest game updates, we’d like to introduce the ExfilZone Creators and the creator program behind them. These creators are an irreplaceable part of our community, helping us connect and engage with players. Be sure to check out the program guidelines—and don’t hesitate to encourage your favorite creators to join us!
https://forms.gle/GTov1i6a1g8NRupX9


With the wipe update, we’ll be running a series of community events soon, including giveaways and group photo challenges using the in-game camera. These initiatives are designed to enhance your experience and strengthen your connection with the community. We’re also open to fun and creative ideas, so feel free to share any event suggestions you think would be a great fit!

Thank you for being a part of our journey. This update wouldn’t mean anything without you. We’ve built this update for you, and we can’t wait to see how you experience it. As always, your feedback is incredibly valuable and has played a big role in shaping the game. With your continued support, we’ll keep refining and expanding ExfilZone. Let’s keep building something great together!

For detailed patch notes and more info, please visit our discord: https://discord.com/invite/contractorsshowdown


Thank you all!

- The ammo reloading machine's storage space has been moved to a new table. The original table now cannot store items.

- Fixed an issue where storage racks had duplicate IDs.
- Resolved an issue where mission items could not be submitted.
- Fixed duplication bugs for graphics cards and ammunition.
- Addressed a crash caused by certain shotguns.
- Fixed an issue where laser sights would render the inbox unusable.
- Resolved task list refresh issues.
- Fixed interaction issues between two junk boxes, where only the box with the higher required item count would be recognized during delivery.
- Fixed an issue where items could be grabbed through walls.
- Addressed synchronization issues with secret room doors.
- Corrected errors in task location descriptions.
- Resolved an issue where bombs would occasionally disappear on their own.
- Fixed a bug where empty fuel canisters could allow players to gain speed boosts.
- Corrected hand texture issues in "Hands Only" mode when picking up and dropping phones.
- Fixed a bug where SECA16 rifles would disappear when placed on the ground.
- Resolved an issue preventing the installation of scopes after laser sights were installed.
- Fixed a bug where uncapped AKs could equip suppressors in incorrect positions.
- Resolved collision issues for weapons like the M3A1 when holstered at the waist.
- Fixed an issue where purchasing shotgun ammo would result in receiving two sets instead of one.
4. Balance Changes
- Improved the armor protection angle to cover chest areas that previously lacked protection.
- Reduced the firing volume of the Sjögren shotgun.
- Adjusted the attributes of 5.56x45mm M995 rounds: decreased penetration level and armor damage, increased base damage (to align with the Christmas event's free ammo giveaway).
- Fixed an issue where the Rampage OD armor would clip through the ground.
- Adjusted shop prices for ammo pouches, helmets, medical syringes, and fuel canisters.
- Resolved a bug preventing bombs from being sold.
5. Miscellaneous Updates
- Reduced the grab detection range for limb repair kits.
- Increased the drop rate for high-quality weapons.
- Decreased the drop rate for blind boxes.

notes.title: Situation Report: Contractors & Contractors Showdown
notes.content:
Hey Contractors Family,

As we approach the end of 2024, we want to take a moment to reflect on this incredible year and share some exciting updates coming your way for both Contractors and Contractors Showdown.

We hope you enjoyed the Halloween headquarters and Pumpkin Head Zombies in Contractors! We know many of you have been asking about our roadmap, and we’re thrilled to announce that a major update is scheduled on November. For Contractors Showdown, we’re especially proud of everything we’ve built together this year. We started 2024 with Alpha tests, and thanks to your feedback, we’re ending it with a brand-new transformation designed just for you.

Now, let’s dive into what’s next for both games!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/f7c0bd5e10979a183f72d406f45f4f8f7c0edf5d.png[/img]

[h1]Contractors mobilized update - MOD KIT
[/h1]
The modding community has consistently delivered amazing content for everyone to enjoy! We’re excited to bring new features to the mod kit, including vehicles, the Rush game mode, and mechanics like vaulting and zip lines. We’re also increasing player numbers to make each session even more intense. Get ready for the next level of Contractors in November!

With these new features and tools enhancing player mobility—thanks to our amazing modding community—we’re confident that Contractors will deliver fresh, exciting experiences. Vehicles and zip lines will bring a whole new rhythm to the game, adding layers of strategy and dynamic movement that keep gameplay fast-paced and engaging.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/c75c403e03757796912a455e5cf55615f5bd284f.png[/img]
[h3]Bhaptic SDK & Forcetube SDK update
[/h3]Both Bhaptic and Forcetube SDK will be updated to match the latest versions.

[h3]Easy-Anti-Cheat Update
[/h3]Contractors VR will also get EAC implemented

[h1]Contractors Showdown update - Transformation [The Next Chapter]
[/h1]

We know it’s been quiet lately, and we owe you an explanation. 

The recent trends in player activity prompted us to pause and rethink the future direction for Contractors Showdown. Our small team at Caveman Studio has been working hard to craft a major update that will bring fresh intensity and depth to the game, with new systems and gameplay features that build on what you already love about Showdown.

Today, we’re excited to hint at what’s to come: Contractors Showdown is preparing for a major evolution. With this update, we’re doubling down on immersion, strategy, and player-driven excitement to create a revitalized experience. We can’t share everything just yet, but rest assured, playtests are on the way, and we’re eager for you to experience it firsthand.

Here are some exciting features that we are working on. Due to the file size limits, for detailed sneak peak, please check out our official website: www.contractorsvr.com/devblog


[h3]#1 Mag Palming will finally be available in Showdown! Experience smoother tactical reloads to keep the action intense and uninterrupted!

#2 Expanded Arsenal: New Weapon Variants and More Categories.

#3 Attachment Rails, Tactical Flashlights, and New Magazine Sizes!! -- Customize Your loadout Like Never Before!

#4 New areas have been introduced on the island, including a mall and a hospital.

#5 Players won’t be alone—matches will now feature a new crew of AI enemies to battle!

#6 Team up with your friends in custom lobbies for a more personal gameplay experience.[/h3]

We know how much the classic Battle Royale mode means to many of you, and we want to reassure you that it’s here to stay. The fast-paced, adrenaline-filled BR experience will remain a core part of Contractors Showdown, so you’ll still be able to dive into those intense matches you know and love. With this update, you’ll get the best of both worlds, enjoying the original BR mode alongside a fresh new gameplay experience—each offering its excitement and challenges.

For the upcoming “new season” of Contractors Showdown, we know you probably have a lot of questions—and we’re thrilled to see your excitement! Rest assured, we’ll be sharing more sneak peeks and details very soon. We’d also like to invite all of you to participate in the upcoming playtest, and we can’t wait to work together again to make this “new season” the best one yet!

Thank you for sticking with us, for your patience, and for sharing this journey. We’re so grateful for this community and excited about what’s coming next. Keep an eye out for more updates soon—we’re just getting started, and we can’t wait to see where this next chapter takes us.

notes.title: The Final Pre-Season Sitrep
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/3ce87438ede20dd04e0124853b0cb806985aa4d4.png[/img]

[h1]Attention, Contractors![/h1]

We’re almost there. Season 1 is on the horizon, and we’re about to witness history. The grandest showdowns are bound to happen within a few days, and we’re all here to experience it.

Some Contractors had lady luck on their sides, letting them have a taste of what’s to come. Others aren’t so lucky at all - but time draws near for the shifting of the balance. The first-ever season of Contractors Showdown comes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/fa27d1d07ca25984263dea60da036df6c3bd1b1f.gif[/img]

In this sitrep, we’ll be talking about the hottest new features to come on Contractors Showdown Season 1. The Ark Pit, Reborn Mode, the vehicles, melee, a new LMG, never-before-seen explosives, new areas both on the map and at HQ, a weather system, the compass, and the drone.

Yes, this sitrep carries it all. We’re ready. Are you Ready? Let’s get onto it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/2ff64f99dfcf7bcabf0bcc12cb4dac682b27791b.png[/img]

[h2][b]Contractors Showdown: Season 1 Release Details[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/856552dff0a3a8ba63821729ca1d203e852b1e6b.png[/img]

Before anything else - a reminder to all our loyal Contractors. Here are the details of Contractors Showdown Season 1 release:

[h3][b]CONTRACTORS SHOWDOWN SEASON 1[/b]
[b]RELEASE DATE & TIME:[/b] Thursday, July 25th 2024 @ 10:00AM PDT
[b]PLATFORMS:[/b] SteamVR, Meta Quest, Rift[/h3]

[b]Note:[/b] If you've purchased Contractors Showdown on Meta Quest, you'll automatically have access to the Rift Version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/2ff64f99dfcf7bcabf0bcc12cb4dac682b27791b.png[/img]

[h2][b]What’s Coming on Season 1[/b][/h2]

Now, for the part that you’re all waiting for - what exactly is coming to Season 1? If you’re a good Contractor, you may have already sensed the seismic shift that’ll occur once the season starts.

Get ready as we’re about to blow your minds and further exceed the expectations on our beloved VR Battle Royale!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]The Ark Pit: Failure is not Final[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/c761c628a4b8917bf1f89b470c5ab87890929155.png[/img]

There’s no room for 2nd chances - at least there WASN’T. This Season 1, ARK Industry unveiled a new method for Contractors to attain victory - one way or another.

Worried that you might not make it ‘til the end of the showdown? When defeated in battle on the island, you’ll be escorted by [spoiler] <REDACTED> [/spoiler] into the ARK PIT.

Little is known whether the ARK PIT is a prison or a camp - but it damn well looks like an arena for modern gladiators. Contractors are expected to fight to the death as they challenge one another for another shot at victory back on the island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/98a8d4aaae975c11d8299400fa4c360fef73818c.gif[/img]

While the ARK PIT introduces a new path to victory even for those who have fallen, a new mode has risen to challenge the Contractors out of hiding and to never bring their guard down…

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Reborn Mode - For The Love of Mayhem![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/a8463e9310c25cef169e67a51d88ffe45585f250.png[/img]
We're introducing a new mode that puts an emphasis on mayhem and endless combat - Reborn Mode.

Reborn Mode puts a twist on the standard Trio mode. Hate to be a one-hitter-quitter? In Reborn Mode, you'll survive even if there's only 1 member left in your team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/7f6f88637938caae152e89e148ca822b6a8f8e1a.jpg[/img]
That's the only rule for Reborn Mode. It doesn't matter if you get fragged 3 times, 5, 10, 20 - even a 100! As long as your teammates are alive, you'll respawn - HOWEVER - there's a catch - Revival Time increases with each redeployment!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]The ATV and SUV: The Wheels Are In Motion![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/88d8e4fd060bf01131b51d772f856d61fc5a88d6.gif[/img]

Much has been said about the ATV and the SUV on The Pre-Season Sitrep, but we want to reiterate what it really means for all Contractors on a Showdown - it will be an absolute game changer.

Newly-found speed and protection are offered by the vehicles, in addition to a new way to traverse the map either for resources or just to secure yourself and your teammates in the blue zone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/f037f65dee3608af9496a64db528ef5ca260ad71.gif[/img]

Plus, there’s more to the SUV and ATV than meets the eye. The recent playtests have proven that there’s more to just the SUV and ATV being vehicles as they are - they’re also meant to be used to gain advantage one way or another. Blocking doorways, ramming down opponents, positioning for cover fire, going over walls, using its sound as a bait, mowing down unsuspecting enemies in a drive-by - these have all shown to be effective methods to gaining the upper hand - no matter what.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/7002f0f642f00a5426fc1ca41831d35e11c15aa5.png[/img]

We’ve talked enough about the vehicles - now it’s time for the big guns - starting with what people are saying is the biggest addition of ‘em all…

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]The Combat Knife: When it all comes down to the blade[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/ddaac06939d143b9c9acf4398c2d4b620dc028c0.gif[/img]

Every jarhead knows that they simply couldn’t 100% rely on their firearms - sometimes, the basics make a whole lot of difference in a firefight.

Introducing - The Combat Knife. Capable of damaging foes without making a mess, the combat knife’s blade are neatly sharpened, enough to cut into flesh easily like butter.

Mind you - this isn’t some run-on-the-mill knife - it’s also throwable. The most skilled Contractors know how to use it even at longer ranges. The sky’s the limit - and when you’re out of bullets - remember that there will always be situations wherein it all comes down to the blade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/437b070c203a063ce29e4d1e604fc70f79839467.gif[/img]

With the basics come the literal big guns - we’re bringing in more than just a gun this time - it’s something made for hunters or survivors, or a certain long-haired muscled individual…

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]The Compound Bow: Rambo Mode[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/b44897835416c58b7908680de1ff7e58a9524b7f.png[/img]

Yes. A Compound Bow. Quite literally a bow that shoots arrows.

The Compound Bow exists not just for the risk-takers, but also for the silent types who’d rather not tell enemies where they’re shooting from.

Made especially to shoot arrows more than anything, the Compound Bow works just like it’s expected - but take note that you’re not Legolas - your quiver is down there with your mags and ammo, not your back.

You can pick up the Compound Bow on the battlefield, or buy yourself one on a vending machine. Just be warned - it works differently than a normal gun - and may require more skill for the damage it inflicts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/47f3a607ad17b1dfff45f4be249b57efdd19be75.gif[/img]

While Rambo loves his compound bow, there’s another addition that’ll soon be another hit - or more likely a hundred hits to Contractors…

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]The PKP: Rat-at-at-at-at-tah and so on![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/e957788b380d6ee781d42908b2ba99de41719641.png[/img]

The PKP - or for the comrades out there - the Pecheneg - comes in hot on Contractors Showdown Season 1. No longer you’ll have to worry about the amount of bullets you need to mow down enemies in a single clip - the PKP boasts an enormous 100-round belt-fed magazine capable of dealing massive damage to whoever, or whatever gets in its way.

Just remember - the PKP is a heavy machine gun. It’s not your ordinary stock-to-the-shoulder rifle, it’s a machine gun meant to be fired from the hip without worrying much about accuracy. Talk about volume vs. precision.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/bbb5987b5aa0b43b6f508fa9fd48060f3302d8c7.gif[/img]

When the PKP goes “Rat-at-at-at-tah”, there’s bound to be something that’ll cause more like a “Ka-boom” than any other. Since vehicles are on the move, somehow, these are now here…

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]The C4: Explosive Game Changers[/b][/h2]

There’s a new explosive on the road - and quite literally, might be on the road somewhere on the map - the C4 packs an explosive punch with the timing meant to satisfy every Contractor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/bcfadba87061b91e712b8407c3e69aeb4f5d9028.png[/img]

With a remote-controlled detonator to provide ease of detonation from a distance - the C4 acts like a trap more than a bomb. Used in scenarios more than just setting traps against vehicles, it can bring an enormous advantage to those lucky enough to procure it in the field.

With these new weapons and explosives coming into play, the need for more space and variation increases. Say “Hello!” to the new arrivals on the map…

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]New Areas: New Town, Airport, and HQ Renovations![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/99f609e43bcc863b50ac170786a51833d2c426cf.gif[/img]

With vehicles now arriving to the island, comes renovations and even new areas on the map and the headquarters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/40abbdfe6f7766a64a6f7c729ce4b48eaed2a027.gif[/img]

There was once an Old Town, but now there’s a New Town to discover. There’s also the newly-built Airport with open hangars and runways.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/5ba81d7ef724671e186c69ddbdcb7199ba712d72.gif[/img]

Our HQ architects, engineers and technicians have also built a bigger base for us - now encompassing more than just one strut on the sea. Now, you can master your driving skills on the all-new circuit loop meant for those who get their blood boiling on racing adrenaline.

Access to new areas both on the island and the headquarters have brought in a new kind of challenge to all Contractors. We all know the showdown doesn’t choose anything and it always happens - rain, or shine…

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]New Weather System: Sunset, Rainy and Foggy[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/5dab27c752d48ed0cc5cf6a8d56c2a48aa64a6fb.gif[/img]

Contractors know when to strap their boots tighter and jam their heels deeper in the soil depending on the weather. Now, the time has come to test it all out on the battlefield.

A Weather System comes to all matches on Contractors Showdown Season 1. Battlefields now come with randomly picked weathers meant to challenge every Contractor out there.

With a new weather system coming to bring out the turmoil into an already chaotic battlefield, there’s a saving grace - a new navigation system that embraces the old…

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]The Compass: Point towards Victory[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/fd4207358e83a5ffeed6805940c5d8db5b627df7.gif[/img]

Lo and Behold - one of the most-awaited features on Contractors Showdown - The Compass. Comes in different types to cater to all Contractors - it has one single objective - to provide directions to more than just one’s self.

Make callouts more than just natural ones - be more technical when directing commands like a true modern soldier. But beware - you’re not the only one with a compass out there.

The Compass brings in a new way to deal with current issues within the battlefield. Now, there’s a way to fly through the problems with ease…

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]The Drone: When you need some airtime![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/15f54fad0830c13a6933c434eaa94edc33f38e1a.gif[/img]

Welcome to the future - Contractor. The Drone brings in mobility and visibility like never before. Using a remote controller, the drone is a quick medium-sized flying machine capable of lifting you further than what you imagined.

The Drone can be a solution to many problems - just as it’s capable of producing more problems for enemies. Keep in mind - you move at a straight vertical when you use the drone. Make sure you’re aware of the risks before lifting off!

The Drone brings in more than just a capable lifting buddy - it’s more of a friend for those who use it well - just like many of the features mentioned above. It’s good to remember that the additions are more or less capable of providing support to all Contractors vying to get that sweet, sweet victory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/2ff64f99dfcf7bcabf0bcc12cb4dac682b27791b.png[/img]

[h2][b]The Pre-Season Sitrep #1[/b][/h2]

Want to learn more about what we’ve said in the past you may have missed? Be a mindful Contractor and go through the first one: The Pre-Season Sitrep!

notes.content:
Dear contractors,


We extend our heartfelt gratitude to all the players who participated in our alpha and beta tests and shared their invaluable feedback. Your dedication, passion, and constructive criticism have been instrumental in shaping the game into the best possible version. Thank you for being an essential part of our community and for making our game even better with your feedback.

[h3][b]Server Time:[/b][/h3]
[u][b]March 29th 10pm est - April 2nd 23:59pm est[/b][/u]

As we gear up for the official launch, the last testing session is up! This is your final chance to experience the game before it hits the shelves.

Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to embark on an unforgettable gaming adventure with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/5cd80227bcfd5c2f2e2aff5ff8607e5d3e526139.png[/img]


Let's check out what's new in the newest build!

[h3]Weaponsmith System[/h3]
Hate to see the simple UI on the weapon bench? Want to try the weapon before using it? Found all the attachments dull? Now, you have the power to customize your weapons like never before. With this innovative system, you can now directly view the stats, as all attachments are now affecting the weapons' stats! With a more intuitive way of browsing the skins and sprays, it's time to build the ultimate weapon of your dreams. Get ready to wield a weapon that not only reflects your style but also enhances your gameplay. Dive into the world of customization and preview your personalized weapon in action. Unleash your creativity and dominate the battlefield like never before!

[h3]Equip Unique attachments[/h3]
In a game where every detail matters, we have revolutionized the attachment system to bring you a diverse array of attachments that go beyond mere cosmetics. Say goodbye to generic attachments and embrace more strategic possibilities. With a wide range of unique attachments at your disposal, each offering distinct advantages and gameplay changes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882062/d8e615961b427ce5e4bef0e56636b170734c097b.gif[/img]

[h3]Map Polishing[/h3]
As you probably have noticed, we have a 16k㎡ huge island in Contractors Showdown. However, despite our best efforts, there are still a few lingering glitches and imperfections that can be found in various locations on the maps. We greatly appreciate all of the support and feedback that you have provided, as it has allowed us to address and fix a multitude of issues while also making significant improvements to numerous sections of the map.
